turns.speaker: Nora
turns.text: The survey suggests attitudes changed dramatically this year. Could the change have been building for longer?

turns.text: Possibly. Earlier interviews describe private doubts that people were less willing to express publicly.

turns.speaker: Nora
turns.text: Then the survey may capture increased willingness to speak as well as a change in belief.

turns.speaker: Samir
turns.text: Yes. Let's distinguish those explanations and look for evidence across more than one year.
turns.translation_fa: بله. توضیح‌ها را جدا کنیم و شواهد بیش از یک سال را بررسی کنیم.

turns.text: Then age alone can't explain the pattern. Local experience of the policy may matter alongside generational attitudes.

turns.text: Then a phased introduction might address the concern more directly than another campaign promoting the principle.

feedback.model_answer: The recent survey may reflect a change in beliefs, but earlier interviews suggest that some doubts already existed privately. Increased willingness to express those doubts could therefore contribute to the apparent suddenness of the shift. We should examine evidence across several years and distinguish changes in attitudes from changes in public expression, rather than assume that one year's figures reveal when the underlying change began.
